summary_1line: After Sumali’s fall, Indrajit routs the gods, Jayanta is captured by Puloman, and Indra rides out with celestial hosts to confront Ravana.

image_candidates.scene_text: Indrajit stands in his chariot unleashing a storm of weapons as darkness spreads across the battlefield and confused gods strike one another.
The Daitya Puloman seizes the warrior Jayanta and plunges with him into the sea amid the chaos of battle.
Indra departs in his radiant chariot surrounded by Rudras, Maruts, and Apsaras while lightning tears through dark clouds above.
